The '''Gk7 Cryocooler''' was a [[Cooling unit/Legends|cooling unit]] fitted to the [[Eksoan/Legends|Eksoan]] [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] that was utilized by the [[E-Web(15) Heavy Repeating Blaster]]. The model, which was an advancement on the [[Gk3 Cryocooler]], allowed the weapon to fire for up to an entire [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] without overheating while offering a higher rate of power flow.<ref name="EGWT" /> The Gk7 was capable of resisting the effects of high [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] fields on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Qat Chrystac/Legends|Qat Chrystac]], although using the weapon in these environments required the unit's [[cooling coil]]s to be replaced after twenty hours of use.<ref name="TLCSB">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>
